name: Fitbit
short_desc: External: connect a Fitbit or Pixel Watch (via Google Health API) so Health gets your sleep, HRV, resting heart rate, Active Zone Minutes and workouts. Needs your own Google developer project.
author: Humanity Labs
description: Connect your Fitbit or Pixel Watch with a guided setup inside the app. You need your own developer credentials: a free Google Cloud project with the Google Health API enabled and a Web OAuth client (the app shows every step with copy buttons). The app keeps a private synced copy and offers it read-only to other apps on this box through the health-data contract; the Health app shows it. No readiness score (Google's API has none). Keys and sign-in stay in the app.
